compiled_state.title: [T2][GREEN] Extend commit-step.sh with skip marker support + update workflow docs
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
Implement skip marker support in commit-step.sh and update verifier to accept .skipped artifacts.

Changes required:
- Add 'dso commit-step skip <name> "<reason>"' subcommand that writes <name>.skipped artifact (JSON: {step, reason, timestamp})
- Update workflow docs to call 'dso commit-step skip <name> "<reason>"' when step is conditionally skipped
  - enforcement.strategy=ci → skip review steps locally
  - SKIP_REVIEW=true → skip review steps
  - commands.test_changed unset → skip changed-tests step
- Extend verifier (compliance-verifier.sh or equivalent) to accept .skipped as valid alternative to .result (no block)

Testing mode: GREEN (makes T1 tests pass)
Dependencies: T1 (6bfc-4128-252c-44fa)
